adminPricing.title: Content.
adminPricing.tone: What you edit without touching the repo.
adminPricing.lead: Texts, questions, projects, blog, sections and prices. Nothing reaches the site until you publish.
adminPricing.pendingBand: Prices changed and not published · {count}. They go out with the Publish button, along with the texts.
adminPricing.vatNote: Every price is without VAT. Anything hidden or deleted never reaches the site or the public file. Clients keep the pack they bought even if you delete it.

sheet.codeHelp: Letters, numbers and underscore. It cannot be changed later: proposals use it.
sheet.name: Name ({lang})
sheet.englishHelp: With no English name, /en shows the Spanish one.
sheet.onSaleHelp: It can be ordered from /servicios and /propuesta.
sheet.visibleHelp: Hidden, it reaches neither the site nor pricing.json.

errors.invalid: Check the fields: something is out of bounds.
errors.code: Invalid code. Packs in capitals (P6), options and extras in lowercase (copywriting).
errors.codeTaken: An item with that code already exists. A code cannot be reused.
errors.name: The Spanish name is missing.
errors.price: Price in whole euros, from 1 to 999999.
errors.weeks: Weeks: a whole number from 1 to 104.
errors.notFound: That item was not found. Reload the page.
errors.deleted: It is deleted: restore it before editing.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

changes.title: Unpublished changes
changes.lead: This is what would change on the site when you publish.
changes.publishPending: Publishing the catalogue joins the publishing of the texts, which is not ready yet: until then changes stay as a draft and the site keeps what is published.
changes.none: The draft matches what is published.
changes.invalid: The draft is not a valid catalogue yet (a price at 0, for example): what changes cannot be computed.
